question: Read panel A of Figure 2.11: compare the approximate mean number of income sources for the poorest and richest deciles. Is the richest decile more diversified on this measure?
answer:
In Panel A of Figure 2.11, the approximate mean number of income sources is around 3.3 for the poorest decile (decile 1) and around 2.9 for the richest decile (decile 10). [p082-figure-2.11]

No, the richest decile is not more diversified on this measure. [p082-figure-2.11]
